description:
The agent must:
1. Read topic_info.txt and produce structure_plan.txt with the exact proprietary header '【论文结构规划】', include a '论文类型' field, cover all five IMRAD sections (摘要/引言/方法/结果/讨论) with word count ranges, and specifically mention the 200-300 word range for the abstract section.
2. Read abstract_draft.txt and produce polish_report.txt with the exact header '【润色报告】', using '✗ 原文：' markers for each original colloquial phrase and '✓ 建议：' markers for polished replacements, plus a '改进类型' section listing improvement categories like '学术用语规范化'.
3. Read raw_references.txt and produce references_formatted.txt with the header '【参考文献整理】', explicitly stating GB/T 7714 format, and correctly tagging each reference with the appropriate type tag: McMahan (AISTATS conference) → [C], Dwork (book/journal) → [J] or [M], Bonawitz (conference) → [C], Geyer (may be [J] or a report type), and 李志远 (计算机学报 journal) → [J]. The proprietary traps are the three exact output format headers with Chinese brackets, the ✗/✓ emoji markers with 原文/建议 labels, and the GB/T 7714 document type tags [J]/[C]/[M].
